scope: Retrieval gain by whether an answer-bearing ranked passage exists and whether the gold string falls inside the 600-character prefix the generator was shown.

definitions.HIDDEN: not SHOWN, but gold_in_text(gold, full stored text) for >=1 ranked passage
definitions.NONE: gold string in no ranked passage
definitions.regimes: static: date year < 2025; fresh: >= 2025; pooled: all 878

bootstrap.unit: weekly quiz id; full quiz set resampled once per draw, all classes/regimes/generators recomputed from the same draw

weightings.question_pooled: mean over questions in the class
weightings.quiz_weighted: mean over quizzes containing >=1 question of the class of the within-quiz class mean; each class has its own quiz denominator, so a contrast compares two differently composed quiz sets

not_causal: Class membership is not randomised (answer position within an article and which articles are retrieved depend on the question). See covariates.

hybrid.covariate_notes: gold_first_visible_offset_chars = smallest raw-character prefix length of any ranked passage whose normalised text contains the normalised gold string (the end position of the first occurrence); SHOWN <= 600 by construction, HIDDEN > 600. closed_book_f1_panel_mean averages the closed-book F1 of the generators listed for this condition. Standardized mean differences use the pooled SD (HIDDEN minus SHOWN).

hybrid_masked.covariate_notes: gold_first_visible_offset_chars = smallest raw-character prefix length of any ranked passage whose normalised text contains the normalised gold string (the end position of the first occurrence); SHOWN <= 600 by construction, HIDDEN > 600. closed_book_f1_panel_mean averages the closed-book F1 of the generators listed for this condition. Standardized mean differences use the pooled SD (HIDDEN minus SHOWN).
